connector.name: CanLII by Vaquill-AI
connector.registryDescription: MCP for CanLII: Canadian case law and legislation metadata (federal, provincial, territorial).
connector.summary: Hosted at canlii-mcp.vaquill.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vaquill-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token gating access to the hosted CanLII MCP endpoint. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.

headers.name: X-CanLII-Token
headers.description: Your CanLII API key. Apply for one at https://www.canlii.org/en/feedback/feedback.html. The server never stores your key.
